title: Siman 375
section: The Virtue of His Torah and His Holy Books

segments.he: לְאֵיזֶה אִילָן, וְהוּא הָלַךְ לְתוֹךְ הַיַּעַר לַעֲשׂוֹת
segments.en: (37.) Once we stood before him at night and spoke with him much about the many Torah discourses he had revealed to us [which now have all been printed — but then his books had not yet been printed]. And I was mentioning before him some Torah discourses and greatly extolling the immensity of the praise of the vastness of his novelties. And likewise many Torah discourses — for every single Torah discourse is an exceedingly wondrous and vast novelty — with which the soul is consumed from the immensity of the sweetness and vastness of the novelty, for one who truly gazes into them. And we were speaking much about this. Afterwards the next morning...
